title: Asset manifest (.gamestudio/assets/manifest.json)
description: Provenance for every generated or imported asset: where it is, how it was made (provider, model, prompt, seed, references), its licence, cost, review status and lineage. studio-gateway appends entries with status "candidate"; art-director and audio-director promote them; licence_check and compliance pre-flight read them. Rules: approved/final assets need approved_by; final assets cannot be placeholders and must carry a licence.

asset.description: One asset file and its provenance.

id.description: Unique asset id, e.g. "spr_golem_flint_t1". Ledger entries and derived assets refer to it.

kind.description: Asset kind; drives import settings, budgets and QC checks.

status.description: Review state: placeholder (stand-in), candidate (generated, not reviewed), approved (passed style review), rejected (keep for lineage, do not ship), final (approved and integrated for release).

placeholder.description: True for stand-in files (mock mode, dry runs, grey boxes). Release checks refuse placeholders.

model.description: Exact model id used, as sent to the provider API.

prompt.description: Full prompt text sent to the generator (after style-lock expansion), for reproducibility.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt, if the provider supports one.

seed.description: Generation seed, when the provider exposes one.

references.description: Reference images or audio given to the generator (style refs, character sheets).

params.description: Other generation parameters (size, steps, duration_sec, loop, transparent...).

licence.description: Licence and usage terms at generation or import time.

cost_usd.description: Actual or estimated cost of producing this asset in USD; 0 for placeholders and handmade assets.

created_at.description: When the asset was created or imported (ISO 8601, UTC).

approved_by.description: Who approved it: a human reviewer for style sign-off. Required when status is approved or final.

style_ref.description: Style bible section or style-lock id the asset was generated against.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the file; detects silent replacement and enables deduplication.

derived_from.description: Ids of source assets this was edited, upscaled, sliced or recoloured from.

allOf.description: Approved and final assets need a named approver (human taste checkpoint).
Final assets cannot be placeholders and must record their licence.

assets.description: Every asset under the project's assets_dir that was generated or imported. Ids must be unique.
